detail.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one beautiful full-screen landscape 16:9 game UI CONCEPT ART PLATE for Little Math Adventure, a children's illustrated fantasy RPG. This is a design exploration, not a production button spritesheet.
Reference 1 is the approved visual language: rich dark navy enamel panels, thin ornate gold trim, cyan edge accents, substantial beveled controls, polished warm storybook rendering. Reference 2 is the actual catacomb rune chamber, use its stone door, blue rune glow and warm lantern mood. Reference 3 is the canonical orange rune fox with cyan runes; preserve its identity.
Primary request: a locked-catacomb progress detail modal over a softly dimmed guild/catacomb setting. Small children who cannot read must understand: practise a specific pictured math skill, approach its door, unlock a trial that can rescue the fox. Be welcoming and achievable.
Composition, on a 1280 by 720 conceptual canvas: one coherent navy-and-gold modal frame at x45 y22 width1190 height675. Header blank gold-edged title inset from x390 y40 to890 y98; a small empty round close-button frame at1165,70. Left column x80..455: tall stone rune doorway artwork in x110..420 y135..435, locked closed with a LARGE clear gold padlock centered near y320 and a softly cyan-lit outline, two warm lanterns. Below it a separate large circular medallion with the canonical rune fox in x170..370 y450..615; a subtle curved trail of golden particles connects the closed door to this future reward. Do not imply fox already earned. Keep left art within its column.
Right column x490..1165: EXACTLY THREE matching horizontal navy-and-gold module cards, at y145..260, y285..400, y425..540. Each has an 85px illustrated icon medallion on the LEFT: top a cluster of RED APPLES with a small clear PLUS pictogram, second red apples with one visibly taken away and a MINUS pictogram, third two groups of blue gems for comparing quantities, no comparison answer shown. Every row has plenty of EMPTY dark area to the right of its icon for code-rendered module label, numerical timing and progress bar. Do NOT draw any bars, ticks, digits or labels inside these empty areas. Each card has one same-size small gold lock medallion at its FAR RIGHT, unlit; top row has a subtle gold/cyan selected rim, other rows equally clear but quieter.
Footer x500..1150 y575..650: ONE EMPTY navy-and-gold horizontal action frame; clear blank interior for runtime icon and label. No other UI strips or stats.
Critical: generate NO LETTERING, NO WORDS, NO DIGITS and NO placeholder pseudo-text. All labels and numerical meters will be runtime HTML in the prototype. No swords or combat HP bars, no coins, no unrelated decorations. All frame surfaces use ONE canonical source design, keep proportions and generous safe insets. No clipped ornaments, no overlaps. High clarity on a tablet. Picture-first composition. This is full-screen concept art with scenery, not a chroma-key production asset.

entrance.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Edit Reference 1, the ACTUAL current GuildScene screenshot of Little Math Adventure. Reference 2 is the companion catacomb UI concept; use only its small stone rune doorway / gold lock language for visual consistency.
Primary change: make the EXISTING far-right archway, x1100..1270 y220..505 on the 1280x720 screenshot, visibly discoverable and clearly a future accessible locked route.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE in the screenshot exactly unchanged: hall, purple Zyx character, central board, current text, bottom buttons, mana fountain, composition, scene positions and camera. Do not redesign the guild or add a floating full-screen window.
Inside the existing rightmost arch, add closed dark stone door leaves engraved with a small FOX rune. Add a vivid but restrained thin cyan glow tracing the existing arch outline, a generous clear golden LOCK centered inside the doorway around x1190 y369, and a small friendly eye pictogram in a blue circular badge just BELOW the lock to mean 'tap to inspect'. It must look tappable even locked, not greyed out. No chains, no ominous skulls.
Below the door, just below its existing Katakomby caption, place ONE compact dark navy/gold pill panel x1117..1260 y550..590, with a small empty speed-meter trough and a gold lock at its right edge. Leave trough EMPTY; actual progress will be drawn in code. Do not add any new lettering or numerals. Keep it separate from the purple mana well.
The children cannot rely on reading: lock means future access, eye means inspect, blue arch glow and clear button surface invite touch. Existing labels stay where they are; no new text. Only the specified arch and new narrow meter may change. Preserve original aspect ratio 16:9, source lighting and original resolution proportions. No bitmap stretching, no clipped ornaments. One canonical navy/gold visual system, no extra side panels.
